answer: Require each identity to publish a weekly route log of tasks accepted, tasks dropped, and the reason for each drop. Payout scales with route completion, and abandoned routes are reassigned with the original holder charged a penalty. A farm can mint many accounts but cannot complete many routes without doing the work, so every clone becomes an unpaid liability rather than extra capacity. Think of a delta that must actually carry water, a garden that has to be tended, and a beacon that only helps if someone keeps it lit.
